amendments.unit: Independent analytical electric-utility group. Record sovereign/diversified owner without automatically consolidating every utility controlled by it. Prevent actual parent/subsidiary duplicate counts.
amendments.rq3_finance: Actual issuance, actual allocated stock, or contemporaneously verified identified outstanding green liability. Historical maturity schedule alone is not contemporaneous confirmation. Preserve all three evidence classes. Source-confirmed annual allocation flows are a fourth separate class only when the entire reporting period lies within the physical window.
amendments.main_window: Longest fully comparable source-supported period within 2019–2024. Ties: latest endpoint, then stronger finance-date resolution. Multiple category/scope rows are retained and never treated as independent groups.
amendments.adjacent_windows: Retained as robustness; missing intermediate-year capacity does not by itself invalidate comparable nonannual endpoints.
amendments.admission: Closed-intake independent group and boundary audit supports33 principal plus4 matched proxy groups; retain question-specific limitations, no submission-readiness claim.
amendments.outstanding_measurement: Use outstanding_identified_bond_liability; value basis remains principal, carrying value, or source lower bound as separately reported. No uniform principal interpretation or amount pooling.
amendments.evidence_tiers: Uniform source-boundary audit separates principal fuel-identified complete or named-subset scope from matched unsplit thermal proxies. Principal 33; proxy extension 4; broad matched 37 in current closed intake. No geographic differentiation.
amendments.stock_boundary_timing: Contextual stock coverage uses [opening,closing]. Admission IDs require a later within-window record; opening-only stock is explicitly conditional, never extrapolated. Issuance uses (opening,closing]; full annual flow periods must fall within the physical interval.
amendments.iberdrola: Principal coal+CCGT subset excludes fuel-unspecified cogeneration; original cogeneration-inclusive source vectors retained as sensitivity.

forbidden: mixed-debt quantities represented as pure bonds

retrospective_sensitivities.status: Declared after inspecting data; not preregistered
retrospective_sensitivities.technology: Same-scope wind-plus-solar where both actual components exist, excluding compound Solar&Other and missing-as-zero
retrospective_sensitivities.temporal: Finance-aligned adjacent intervals and pre-first-observed-finance fraction of longer window; not causal post-issuance change
